capability: Protocol-aware managed-version mutation fence and launcher-owner deletion protection
searchEvidence: VersionManagementExperience is the sole install/delete/source/activation mutation owner and already serializes through the exact app-state lease.
LauncherBootstrapCoordinator releases that lease while supervising a process, so the durable launcher Pending transaction must also be inspected by every mutator.
VersionManagementPolicy is the sole delete decision owner; no launcher-owner protection projection or rollback-retirement command existed before ADR 0056.
JsonLauncherBootstrapStateStore is the sole launcher journal adapter and intentionally declares no second lease.
semanticOwner: VersionManagement Application mutation policy over one read/retire port; Infrastructure only projects and atomically persists the strict launcher journal under the caller-held app-state lease
terminalContract: Every managed-version state or filesystem mutation fails closed while launcher activation is pending or the launcher journal is invalid/unavailable; active and pending launcher owner admissions cannot be deleted; a last-known-good-only owner is durably rehomed to the active launcher after the existing rollback-loss confirmation and before app deletion; recovery repeats the same protection; no second writer lease is introduced.

designReview.evidence: ADR 0056 production admission explicitly requires a protocol-aware logical mutation fence, exact active/LKG/pending owner deletion protection, and durable LKG retire-before-delete under the existing app-state lease.
